summary: Moves type-checking to native TypeScript 7, tests to Vitest 5, adds oxlint and journey type-checking, removes dead code and rebalances browser-journey shards.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Development tooling only: TypeScript 7 rejects baseUrl, so path aliases now resolve through paths alone, and compiler-API scripts use @typescript/typescript6.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage or journal schema change. Post engine API remains 1; saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, WebMCP tool, cancellation or input-version behavior change. Program-tree keyboard expansion keeps the same behavior after a ternary statement became an if/else.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change. Removed code was unreferenced: unused helpers, imports and an unused CAD tab state.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change and no cleanup of user files.
checklist.verification: Rebased onto 0.0.702 main, which made sketch arc bounds exact and fixed the mixed path drawing journey that failed this PR's first CI run. Native tsc -b (now including e2e and playwright.config.ts), npm run lint with zero findings, the shared UI gate, icon checks, post-authoring docs check, production build with documentation and third-party source verification pass. Vitest 5 full suite: 5,675 of 5,677 tests pass locally; the two CAD workbench interaction tests that timed out at 5 s run in about 0.5 s on an idle machine and timed out only under heavy unrelated local CPU load (they also time out on main with Vitest 4 under the same load). The journeys using the shared onboarding helpers and the changed worker shim pass locally; CI runs every journey across four shards.

publicNotes.summary: Faster internal checks; no workbench behavior changes.
changes: Internal type, lint and test checks run faster and cover the browser journeys, so regressions are caught before release.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged.
